components.name: Spring and Hook
components.description: One spot in a class: a taut tension-coloured spring on an ink hook when booked, a slack steel spring over a dashed hook when open.
components.html: MR+
components.css: .ds-springs { display: flex; gap: 32px; padding: 0 16px; } .ds-spot { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; height: 128px; } .ds-coil { width: 16px; transition: height 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-taut { height: calc(100% - 28px); color: oklch(0.6 0.2 25); } .ds-slack { height: 40px; color: oklch(0.47 0.015 320); } .ds-hook { margin-top: auto; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 2px solid oklch(0.21 0.03 335); background: oklch(0.21 0.03 335); color: oklch(0.945 0.004 300); font: 700 11px Archivo, sans-serif; } .ds-open { border-style: dashed; border-color: oklch(0.47 0.015 320); background: oklch(0.945 0.004 300); color: oklch(0.47 0.015 320); } .ds-spot:hover .ds-slack { height: 56px; }

narrative.overview: The page is a Pilates reformer seen from the side. Aubergine upholstery is the carriage that carries the big statements; aluminium is the frame and the ground everything else sits on; springs hang between them and stand for spots in a class. A booked spot is a spring hooked on and pulled taut in its tension colour. An open spot is a slack steel spring above an empty, dashed hook. Density is low and the scale contrast is high. Hierarchy comes from size and width of one typeface, not from ornament. The material is never faked: there are no stitch lines, no bevels and no brushed-metal stripes. The upholstery and aluminium are flat colour fields with one soft drop shadow, and the springs are the only drawn objects.
keyCharacteristics: Two grounds only: aubergine upholstery fields and cool aluminium.
Tension colour (red, yellow, green, blue) marks an engaged spring; at rest everything is steel or aluminium.
One family, Archivo, used across its width axis: expanded for display, normal for reading, condensed for stamped labels.
Pill rails and pill buttons; 2rem panels; round hooks.

rules.name: The Engaged Colour Rule
rules.body: Tension colour appears only on a spring that is hooked on. A spring at rest, or a spring used as an icon, is steel on aluminium or soft aubergine-white on upholstery.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: Every section sits on aluminium or on a full aubergine panel. No third ground, no gradients between them.

rules.name: The Size Is Billing Rule
rules.body: Importance is carried by size and width alone. Stats run as stacked lines of display type, heavy expanded figures followed by light normal-width words, with no separators or icons.

dos: Do set the biggest statements on full-width aubergine panels and everything else on aluminium.
Do colour a spring only when it is hooked on (The Engaged Colour Rule).
Do draw open spots as deliberately as booked ones: slack steel spring, dashed hook.
Do carry hierarchy with Archivo's width and weight, not with extra colour.
donts: Don't fake material: no stitch lines, inset bevels or striped metal textures.
Don't use tension colours as decoration on resting icons or separators.
Don't add a third ground colour or gradients between the two grounds.
Don't set eyebrow labels above headings; the condensed label style belongs to the spring bar readout only.
